metrics.title: Discipline
metrics.question: Holds off until entry conditions are met; backtests make the right call

metrics.title: Refusal calibration
metrics.question: Abstains when it should, commits when the evidence is there, is not pushed by the user's tone

metrics.title: Decidable conditions
metrics.question: Conditions name a data series or source, a rule, a window, and a threshold or a reason it is open

metrics.title: Grounding
metrics.question: Edges rest on cited evidence instead of model-only inference; no leaks or laundered citations

metrics.title: Fork integrity
metrics.question: Changing an assumption touches only the write scope and challenges the right claims

metrics.title: Research lift
metrics.question: The follow-up web search leaves fewer evidence gaps than round 1
